steps: Explicit v1 conversion copies all five actions to each eligible frozen target; cancel preserves the v1 draft, range edits affect only the selected instance, and target selection retains text and focus in three languages.
The v2 document is explicitly saved and reloaded byte-for-byte; rejecting a dirty replacement retains the draft and does not write.

A real fixed-step Godot v2 run independently directs shared-definition characters, detects staggered jump edges and wall collision, leaves omitted/non-controlled characters stationary, and preserves full observation identities and frozen project bytes. V1 still broadcasts to all three eligible instances.

The saved v2 replay and full dependency closure are imported into a separate workspace, explicitly attached to a new project assembly and rebuilt. With the original author workspace renamed offline, the restored replay again drives the same identities and staggered jumps; both workspaces remain byte-identical.
